name: American Icons: Pop Culture, Star Power

assessments.name: Research paper
assessments.description: Students will submit an original research paper that reflects the themes of the unit and builds upon their research proposal. The research paper should make an original argument that is grounded in an analysis of primary and secondary sources.
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 19 Nov 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 29 Nov 2026

assessments.name: Participation
assessments.description: Students will engage in active, informed participation in tutorial.

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task
assessments.description: Students will complete a short quiz in tutorial

assessments.name: Research paper proposal
assessments.description: Students will write a 1000-word research proposal (bibliography not included in word count). The proposal will identify a topic, a research question, a set of 3-5 primary sources, and a minimum of 5 secondary sources.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 07 Due date : 18 Sep 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 28 Sep 2026

assessments.name: Annotated article
assessments.description: Students will annotate a book chapter or article as part of their research project. Students should submit a marked-up article, including highlighted passages and notes in the margins reflecting the key ideas and evidence of the chapter or article.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 10 Due date : 16 Oct 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 26 Oct 2026

assessments.name: Presentation
assessments.description: Students will give a 5-minute presentation on their research topic to their peers in tutorial. Students will analyse one or two examples (images, scenes, lyrics) from their research to illustrate their argument.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement
